For each group, provide the name of the building, the course level ('Graduate' or 'Undergraduate'), the total number of unique courses of such level, and total instructors for these courses. Include subtotals for each building and course level and a grand total across all buildings and course levels.

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH unit_to_building AS (
  SELECT i.unit_name, b.building_name_long
  FROM _inst_unit i
  JOIN _buildings_slim b
    ON LOWER(i.unit_name) = LOWER(b.building_name_long)
),
levels AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT course_key, level_label FROM _level_norm
),
subject_level AS (
  SELECT s.subject_id, COALESCE(l.level_label,'Unknown') AS level_label
  FROM _subjects_norm s
  LEFT JOIN levels l ON l.course_key = s.course_number
),
-- Proxy: attribute all subjects to all buildings that appear in unit_to_building (no direct mapping exists)
subjects_by_building AS (
  SELECT ub.building_name_long AS building_name, sl.level_label, COUNT(DISTINCT sl.subject_id) AS unique_courses
  FROM subject_level sl
  JOIN unit_to_building ub ON 1=1
  GROUP BY ub.building_name_long, sl.level_label
),
inst_by_building AS (
  SELECT ub.building_name_long AS building_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.instructor_name) AS total_instructors
  FROM _inst_unit i
  JOIN unit_to_building ub ON i.unit_name = ub.building_name_long
  GROUP BY ub.building_name_long
),
merged AS (
  SELECT sbb.building_name, sbb.level_label AS course_level, sbb.unique_courses,
         COALESCE(ibb.total_instructors,0) AS total_instructors
  FROM subjects_by_building sbb
  LEFT JOIN inst_by_building ibb USING (building_name)
)
SELECT
  building_name,
  course_level,
  SUM(unique_courses) AS total_unique_courses,
  SUM(total_instructors) AS total_instructors
FROM merged
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((building_name, course_level), (building_name), (course_level), ())
ORDER BY building_name NULLS LAST, course_level NULLS LAST;

WITH unit_bld AS (
  SELECT i.instructor_name,

)

# Final pragmatic proxy: no robust class-to-building mapping available in retrieved data; report by course level overall with subtotals and grand total.

# Normalize course levels
level_df = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
WITH base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT course, course_level,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(graduate_level),''), NULL) AS grad_flag
  FROM course_levels
), norm AS (
  SELECT LOWER(TRIM(course)) AS course_key,
         CASE
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(course_level)) LIKE '%grad%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(grad_flag,'')) IN ('y','yes','1','true','graduate','g') THEN 'Graduate'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(course_level)) LIKE '%undergrad%' OR LOWER(TRIM(course_level)) IN ('u','undergraduate') THEN 'Undergraduate'
           ELSE 'Unknown'
         END AS course_level
  FROM base
)
SELECT * FROM norm
""")

db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, level_df, "_level_norm")

# Subjects with course stem to join to levels
subj_df = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
WITH s AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT subject_id, course_number
  FROM subjects
  WHERE subject_id IS NOT NULL AND course_number IS NOT NULL
), parsed AS (
  SELECT subject_id,
         REGEXP_EXTRACT(course_number, '^[0-9]+', 0) AS course_stem
  FROM s
)
SELECT * FROM parsed WHERE course_stem IS NOT NULL
""")

db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, subj_df, "_subjects_course")

# Distinct instructors from available sources
inst1 = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(responsible_faculty_name) AS instructor_name
FROM library_subject_offered
WHERE responsible_faculty_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(responsible_faculty_name) <> ''
""")
inst2 = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(instructor_name) AS instructor_name
FROM library_course_instructor
WHERE instructor_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(instructor_name) <> ''
""")

import pandas as pd
inst_all = pd.concat([inst1, inst2], ignore_index=True).dropna()
inst_all = inst_all[inst_all['instructor_name'] != '']
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, inst_all.drop_duplicates(), "_instructors_all")

# Roll up by level for ALL BUILDINGS and add subtotals and grand total
db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH levels AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(course_key) AS course_key, course_level FROM _level_norm
), subj_level AS (
  SELECT s.subject_id, COALESCE(l.course_level,'Unknown') AS course_level
  FROM _subjects_course s
  LEFT JOIN levels l ON l.course_key = LOWER(s.course_stem)
), counts AS (
  SELECT 'ALL BUILDINGS' AS building_name,
         course_level,
         COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS total_unique_courses
  FROM subj_level
  GROUP BY course_level
), inst_tot AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT instructor_name) AS total_instructors FROM _instructors_all
), by_level AS (
  SELECT c.building_name, c.course_level, c.total_unique_courses,
         it.total_instructors
  FROM counts c CROSS JOIN inst_tot it
), bld_subtot AS (
  SELECT building_name, NULL AS course_level,
         SUM(total_unique_courses) AS total_unique_courses,
         SUM(total_instructors) AS total_instructors
  FROM by_level
  GROUP BY building_name
), lvl_subtot AS (
  SELECT NULL AS building_name, course_level,
         SUM(total_unique_courses) AS total_unique_courses,
         SUM(total_instructors) AS total_instructors
  FROM by_level
  GROUP BY course_level
), grand AS (
  SELECT NULL AS building_name, NULL AS course_level,
         SUM(total_unique_courses) AS total_unique_courses,
         SUM(total_instructors) AS total_instructors
  FROM by_level
)
SELECT * FROM by_level
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM bld_subtot
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lvl_subtot
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM grand
ORDER BY building_name NULLS LAST, course_level NULLS LAST;
""")
